summary: The candidate keeps two normalized metadata fields under caller control. Both issues break the trusted packet boundary.

blocking_findings.title: Caller-controlled school identifiers alter normalized output and acceptance classification
blocking_findings.context: The code copies variantId and groups ambiguity from the caller document. The trusted packet has no facts for either value.
blocking_findings.impact: A caller reused unchanged genuine preparations, injected two variant IDs, and changed a ready batch to unresolved.
blocking_findings.scope_decision: variantId is a document identifier. ambiguityGroupId is metadata that controls the ready or unresolved decision. Both require trust binding.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Add source-stated packet facts for both values. Require exact singleton bindings, derive the output and grouping, and reject caller contradictions.

blocking_findings.title: Caller-controlled receipt tax status changes trusted normalized output
blocking_findings.context: The code copies thaiTaxDocumentStatus from the caller. The trusted packet has no matching fact or deterministic derivation.
blocking_findings.impact: The same genuine receipt preparation produced not-source-asserted or unresolved after changing only the caller field.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Derive this status from trusted source facts or a fixed document-kind rule. Reject every caller contradiction.
